Noncompleted responses remain inspectable with no tool dispatch. Native and recovered effective output preserve native metadata and provenance. Former CLI consistency regressions migrated to adapter coverage. Public WS/SSE sessions reject discarded/changed text or finalized items, identity/index/type/metadata contradictions and byte/item/event overflow before publication/execution/next send. Settlement test checks no conversation settlement; positive interleaving, compatible output and request reset remain covered.

Wrong session/provider/request, response identity, repeated/decreasing sequence, duplicate start, idle null-request close and EOF fail without continuation. Gaps and terminal-only streams pass; unchanged nested envelopes are compared by healthy helper. The adapter decoder synchronously rejects an exact second terminal with event after terminal response and retains created-after-terminal rejection; collector adds no postterminal wait.

A at model limit 1 executes no tool; B at 2 executes only first tool with two attempts. Cached batch at limit is not replayed. Final text at last allowed request completes. Rejected attempts count independently of receipts and preserve uncertainty.

Zero tools permits T but not A. Two-new-call batch with one slot rejects atomically. Cached/new pair requires one new slot. Replay at 128 succeeds; 129th new ID and ninth batch call reject before dispatch.

Identical same-run delivery reuses one result. Changed arguments or tool under a saved ID reject. Two runs execute independently with fresh run/session ownership and preserve the template cache; tool Arcs alone are shared.

Pre-cancel rejects before admission; deterministic pending open/generate/output and pending/between-tool cancellation stop later work. Healthy admitted cancellation finishes locally once; no fabricated finish/result or partial submission. Before generation is not_submitted; pending attempts remain unknown unless a validated response exists. Before any turn, upstream assessment is null.

Paused time covers open/generate/output/tools; completed early turn does not reset absolute deadline. Simultaneously ready cancellation wins. Terminal disposition is classified before a new stop checkpoint, so observer cancellation on a completed no-call terminal does not rewrite completion; call-bearing responses still checkpoint before tool work. No wall-clock race, external rollback or blocking-kernel guarantee.

Checked-add overflow and oversized output produce bounded correlated error results consumable on continuation. Invalid authority/schema is preflight failure. Partial batch stop submits no subset; cancelled pending tool creates no fabricated result.

Preflight/generate rejection, failed receipt, HTTP 401/403/429 and post-send disconnect/error stop at one attempt per step without reopen/retry/fallback. Fake events cover exact not_submitted/unknown/terminal_received propagation, including terminal-valid local failure. Counters do not alter the live ledger.

Healthy helper compares nested envelopes, IDs, sequence and recorded attempts/admissions/tool work across T/A/B and stopped traces. First/last lifecycle and one finish per started turn are checked; open failure has no turn. Terminal-observer cancellation ends with ModelCompleted and RunFinished(Completed), retained TerminalReceived, one request and zero tool work. Dispatch counter counts accepted dispatch boundaries, including cancellation before the tool body after accepted start delivery. No fabricated agent/message/steering events.

Full/Closed/Failed at start/provider/tool start stop emissions and later work, events_complete=false. Final delivery error retains selected outcome with sink_error and no second terminal; CLI exits 1. Bounded try_send adapter and future-drop close guard are exercised. No transcript queue/detached tool task or guaranteed return/final event after drop.

Fake/loopback provider opens once; auth observer records preparation/load at existing provider boundaries (WS once, SSE open plus each submission), not controller auth calls. Inherited managed selection/incarnation/renewal/store/read-only-source suites remain green with isolated HOME/XDG_CONFIG_HOME/CODEX_HOME and absent live paths. No production auth module changes or rotation-worker policy changes.
